description: Experimental dataset on a large-scale urban drainage physical facility is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Esteban Sañudo, Luis Cea (University of A Coruña). The present dataset contains the results from the test carried out at a large-scale urban drainage facility located in the Hydraulics Laboratory of the Centre of Technological Innovation in Construction and Civil Engineering (CITEEC) at the University of A Coruña (Spain) within the scope of the project SATURNO - Early warning against pluvial flooding in ... Coverage: national (ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
